name: Impressionism
intro: Eighteen pictures, from Manet’s Olympia to Monet’s water lilies, each with one thing to look for.
homeDescription: Eighteen works show how to recognize Impressionism, from Manet and Monet to Morisot, Degas, Renoir, Caillebotte and Cassatt.
ldDescription: A short guide to recognizing French Impressionism, 1863–1906, in eighteen works, compiled from museum collection records.
sourcesDescription: Lectures, curricula, museum collection records and reference sources used to compile {name}.
